description: This file defines the SearchQuery interface which represents a query for searching properties within the Ditto model. It includes methods for building a new query, retrieving filter and options, and generating string representations.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: An interface representing a search query with methods to retrieve filter, options, and string representations.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable SearchQuery using a specified search filter.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns the main search filter of the query.

methods.name: getFilterAsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the search filter.

methods.name: getSortOption
methods.description: Returns an optional sort option for the search results.

methods.name: getLimitOption
methods.description: Returns an optional limit/pagination option for the search results.

methods.name: getAllOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of all options associated with the query.

methods.name: getOptionsAsString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing all options in the query.
